primary_population.invalid_endpoint_action: invalidate the affected phase for every method; never method-specific exclusion

green_decision.invalid_intent_to_analyze_treatment: warning plus separately reported method-invalid rate
green_decision.interpretation: only a preregistered positive certificate accepts transport; every inconclusive or opposite-sign result warns

nonprimary_comparator_roles.integrated_gradients: quadrature convergence ablation of finite response; not an independent win
nonprimary_comparator_roles.single_point_hvp: weaker second-order ablation; not a substitute for ms_hvp
nonprimary_comparator_roles.normalized_finite_response_mismatch: descriptive rescaling of finite mismatch; not an independent win
nonprimary_comparator_roles.grant_divergence: cohort-level reference diagnostic only; never broadcast to rows
nonprimary_comparator_roles.atp_star: N/A for coarse full-residual nodes; no claim that exact patching executes or beats AtP-star
nonprimary_comparator_roles.generic_verifier: same-estimand comparator only if scalar-t four-branch Psi wrapper is operational; otherwise N/A without a GREEN win

primary_comparison.name: prompt_clustered_matched_coverage_selective_risk
primary_comparison.baseline_acceptance: within each sealed phase, accept exactly K lowest-risk rows where K is GREEN accepted count; tie break by row_id; endpoint values never used
primary_comparison.risk: mean primary continuous endpoint among accepted rows
primary_comparison.contrast: GREEN accepted risk minus comparator accepted risk; lower favors GREEN
primary_comparison.simultaneous_method: max-absolute-deviation cluster bootstrap across primary comparators

secondary_comparison.threshold_objective: minimize balanced error with deterministic lower-threshold tie break
secondary_comparison.threshold_reuse: unchanged on IOI confirmation and every Greater-Than phase
secondary_comparison.multiplicity: Holm correction over primary row-level comparators

phase_policy.development: fit only prespecified comparator thresholds and perform protocol diagnostics
phase_policy.greater_than_description: prospective held-out prompt-universe replication on a previously studied benchmark

oral_success_gate.ioi_confirmation: minimum GREEN coverage met and simultaneous upper confidence bound for every primary selective-risk contrast is below 0
oral_success_gate.greater_than_replication: minimum GREEN coverage met, every primary contrast is directionally below 0, and at least one simultaneous max-deviation upper bound is below 0
